statement: Five reproducible structure-based affinity pipelines performed best on experimental co-crystal inputs and generally degraded when evaluated on docked apo, predicted-receptor or AlphaFold3-cofolded structures, demonstrating a benchmark-to-deployment input-structure gap.
locator: Abstract and Results; Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling (2026), DOI 10.1021/acs.jcim.6c00592
notes: Useful for decomposing end-to-end error into structure-generation and scoring components.
